# The word ORGANON as an Organon legibility fixture (PBR text, organon#217).
#
# Source: `native/assets/text/organon.txt` — the demo text the producer is fed, generated
# from a 5x7 pixel font at two cells per pixel (2:1 cell aspect -> square pixels). Every
# cell is `█` or blank, so there is no half-block coverage and no `colours` block: the
# fixture is the shape alone, one colour. Census: 7 rows x 82 columns = 574 cells, lit
# 240 (counted by `the_organon_fixture_is_the_demo_text_cell_for_cell` in
# tests/legibility.rs).
#
# There is NO blank padding row, above or below, and that is load-bearing rather than
# tidiness: ttfx strips trailing spaces from an input line, so an all-space row becomes an
# EMPTY line; it then drops trailing empty lines outright; and its default `sw` text anchor
# leaves the glyph block sitting on the canvas floor. So every row of slack between the
# text and `--rows` surfaces at the TOP of the published grid and none at the bottom, and a
# fixture padded above AND below describes a grid the producer cannot publish for any
# `--rows` at all. That is what made this gate abort with "the ring's text is not the
# fixture's: 220 cell(s) differ" from #246 until W20. `no_fixture_carries_a_blank_bottom_row`
# in tests/legibility.rs is the standing guard.
#
# The colour is the same Tokyo Night foreground `omarchy-logo.txt` uses, for the same
# reason — not pure white — and it is inert in the gate, which reads colours from the ring.
# Format: native/organon-render/src/legibility.rs, `Fixture::parse`.
grid v1
cols 82
rows 7
aspect 2
order top-down
default #c0caf5
glyphs
|  ██████    ████████      ██████      ██████    ██      ██    ██████    ██      ██|
|██      ██  ██      ██  ██      ██  ██      ██  ████    ██  ██      ██  ████    ██|
|██      ██  ██      ██  ██          ██      ██  ██  ██  ██  ██      ██  ██  ██  ██|
|██      ██  ████████    ██  ██████  ██████████  ██    ████  ██      ██  ██    ████|
|██      ██  ██  ██      ██      ██  ██      ██  ██      ██  ██      ██  ██      ██|
|██      ██  ██    ██    ██      ██  ██      ██  ██      ██  ██      ██  ██      ██|
|  ██████    ██      ██    ████████  ██      ██  ██      ██    ██████    ██      ██|
